mapper.select: SELECT MAX(t.id) FROM sys_group AS t
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_group SET grht = grht + 2 WHERE grht > #{gleft, jdbcType=INTEGER}
UPDATE sys_group SET glft = glft + 2 WHERE glft > #{gleft, jdbcType=INTEGER}
UPDATE sys_group SET grht = grht - #{gvalue, jdbcType=INTEGER} WHERE grht > #{gright, jdbcType=INTEGER}
UPDATE sys_group SET glft = glft - #{gvalue, jdbcType=INTEGER} WHERE glft > #{gright, jdbcType=INTEGER}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_group WHERE glft BETWEEN #{gleft, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND #{gright, jdbcType=INTEGER}
mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.grht, g.glft, g.group_name, g.parent_id, g.group_level FROM sys_user_group as ug left join sys_group AS g on ug.group_id = g.id where ug.user_id = #{uid, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and g.be_deleted = 0
SELECT DISTINCT g.id, g.group_level, g.group_name FROM sys_group cg LEFT JOIN sys_group g ON cg.parent_id LIKE CONCAT(g.id, '%') AND g.group_level = 1 WHERE cg.id = #{id, jdbcType=CHAR}
